title: SciREPL translation span manifest
description: Records which spans of a translated workbook's code cells may differ from the source, and where those differences may surface in executed output. Emitted in two forms with the SAME shape: 'derived' (authoritative — produced by the static gate's diff of source vs target code cells) and 'worker' (cross-check — produced by the translating agent). The gate compares the two; see docs/pilot/span-manifest.md for semantics.

produced_by.description: 'derived' = extracted mechanically by the gate; 'worker' = declared by the translating agent as a cross-check.

generator.description: Tool and version that emitted this manifest, e.g. 'extract-spans.mjs@0.1.0' or 'agy-gemini-flash'. Optional on worker manifests, required on derived ones.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the target locale, e.g. 'es'.

spans.description: Canonical order: sorted by (cell_index, source_span.start.line, source_span.start.col). Comparison between worker and derived manifests is set-based after this canonicalization.

exclusions.description: Output channels excluded from the differential oracle because the determinism envelope showed they are not reproducible run-to-run. Empty means fully deterministic — expected for compute-pi.

selector.description: What is excluded, in gate-consumable form, e.g. a line-regex for stdout or a cell name for plot.

sha256.description: Hash of the exact bytes the manifest describes. Binds the manifest to the artifacts so a stale manifest fails loudly.

line.description: 1-based line within the cell's code text (not the file).

col.description: 1-based column counted in Unicode code points (not bytes, not UTF-16 units).

text.description: Exact span content. For comments: excludes the leading '#' and one following space. For strings: excludes the quote delimiters and any f/r/b prefix. For docstrings: the full docstring content.

cell_index.description: Zero-based index into the notebook's cell array.

cell_name.description: Stored cell name (informative; identity is cell_index). Empty string for unnamed cells.

kind.description: plot_label is a display_string whose destination is a rendered figure rather than stdout — routed to the plot check instead of the text oracle.

reaches_output.description: Where a correct translation of this span may cause executed-output differences. comments/docstrings: 'none' (unless __doc__ is printed — then 'stdout'). print literals: 'stdout'. trace names / plot titles: 'plot'.

placeholders.description: Ordered placeholder/format tokens of the ENCLOSING string token (e.g. ['{lower:.12f}', '{upper:.12f}']), identical between source and target — the gate asserts this. Empty for comments, docstrings without braces, and plain strings.
